# LAB_STEPS

Plan steps a floe contributes, keyed by step name.

<!-- Generated by nix/signature-docs.nix. Refresh: nix run .#refresh-docs -->

Canonically `step`. A floe providing this must declare it
as `provides.step`; a hole that resolves it may be called
anything.
